label: rem:categorical-connection-remark
title: Classical connections and $A$-linearity of curvature
html: A categorical connection generalizes the classical de Rham connection d; the \mathrm{SU}(2) instance in Example gives a concrete picture. Its curvature F_\nabla = \nabla^2 is A-linear, a standard consequence of the Leibniz rule.
heading: Remark
